name: Etarou
source:
The protagonist, he wakes up in a strange room with a suspicious woman watching him from the monitor. It seems she knows him, yet he can't seem to remember anything about himself nor his past. For some reason, he seems to have brought her anger upon himself and so must escape, avoiding her gaze.

[Translated from [url=https://enoshima210.work/2019/10/04/ae/]official website[/url]]
